definitions.explanation: A title at the top of an article, section, or document.
The entry word in a dictionary or index.

⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{見出|みだ}し⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{報道|ほうどう}された→報道する：04438_houdou⟧。
examples.english: It was reported with a big headline.

notes:
{見出|みだ}し has two main uses: headlines/headings (sense 1) and dictionary headwords (sense 2).

COMPOUND: {見|み} (see) + {出|だ}し (putting out) — something that stands out to catch the eye.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {見出|みだ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to add a headline/heading
- ⟦{見出|みだ}し{語|ご}→見出し語：24989_midashigo⟧: headword (in a dictionary)
- ⟦{大|おお}{見出|みだ}し→大見出し：noentry⟧: main headline
- ⟦{小|こ}{見出|みだ}し→小見出し：noentry⟧: subheading
- ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧{見出|みだ}し: eye-catching headline

USAGE:
- ⟦{新聞|しんぶん}→新聞：01440_shinbun⟧: newspaper headlines
- ⟦{雑誌|ざっし}→雑誌：00686_zasshi⟧: magazine section titles
- ⟦{辞書|じしょ}→辞書：04707_jisho⟧: dictionary entry words
- ⟦{文書|ぶんしょ}→文書：12947_bunsho⟧: document headings
